package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/metastore"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/transport/httprest"
)

type preciseTestFixture struct {
	authority *nativeAuthority
	history   *preciseHistory
	remote    *httprest.Storage
	stream    *preciseHistoryStream
	file      storage.File
	request   storage.RenameRequest
	action    storage.FileActionID
}

func preciseTestAction(t *testing.T) storage.FileActionID {
	t.Helper()
	id, err := storage.NewFileActionID(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return id
}

func preciseTestTarget(t *testing.T, parent storage.File, name string) storage.EntryTarget {
	t.Helper()
	at, err := parent.Stat(t.Context(), storage.ObservationOptions{IncludeLocation: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result := storage.EntryTarget{Parent: parent.Reference(), ParentID: at.Attr.ID, Name: []byte(name), DirectoryRevision: at.Attr.DirectoryRevision, Witness: at.Location}
	page, err := parent.ListAt(t.Context(), storage.DirectoryPageRequest{Revision: at.Attr.DirectoryRevision, MaxEntries: 64, MaxBytes: storage.MaxDirectoryPageBytes})
	if err != nil || !page.Done {
		t.Fatalf("complete target observation: %v %+v", err, page)
	}
	for _, entry := range page.Entries {
		if string(entry.Name) == name {
			result.ExpectedEntryID = entry.EntryID
			result.ExpectedNodeID = entry.Attr.ID
			result.ExpectedMetadataRevision = entry.Attr.MetadataRevision
		}
	}
	return result
}

func preciseTestSetup(t *testing.T) *preciseTestFixture {
	t.Helper()
	a := newNativeAuthority()
	handler, err := httprest.NewHandler(a, a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(handler)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		handler.Stop()
		server.Close()
		if err := handler.Close(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	remote, err := httprest.Dial(server.URL, server.Client())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	session, _, err := remote.NewFileSession(t.Context(), storage.DefaultFileSessionOptions())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if _, err := session.Close(context.Background(), preciseTestAction(t)); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	retained, err := session.Retain(t.Context(), storage.RetainRequest{NodeID: 1}, preciseTestAction(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root, err := session.Reference(t.Context(), retained.Reference)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	create := func(parent storage.File, name string, kind storage.NodeKind) storage.File {
		result, err := session.CreateAndRetainAt(t.Context(), storage.CreateAndRetainRequest{Target: preciseTestTarget(t, parent, name), Initial: storage.NodeInitial{Kind: kind}, Claim: storage.AccessClaim{Uses: storage.AllAccessUses}}, preciseTestAction(t))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		file, err := session.Reference(t.Context(), result.Reference)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return file
	}
	parent := create(root, "v", storage.NodeDirectory)
	create(parent, "target", storage.NodeRegular)
	file := create(parent, "replacement", storage.NodeRegular)
	request := storage.RenameRequest{Source: preciseTestTarget(t, parent, "replacement"), Destination: preciseTestTarget(t, parent, "target")}
	h := newPreciseHistory(a)
	source := h.wrap(smb.ChangeSource{Subscribe: func(ctx context.Context) (smb.ChangeStream, error) { return remote.Subscribe(ctx) }, Resume: func(ctx context.Context, g metastore.Incarnation, p metastore.Position) (smb.ChangeStream, error) {
		return remote.Resubscribe(ctx, g, p)
	}, Checkpoint: func(ctx context.Context) (metastore.LogBarrier, error) {
		b, err := remote.Checkpoint(ctx)
		return metastore.LogBarrier{Incarnation: metastore.Incarnation(b.Incarnation), Position: metastore.Position(b.Position)}, err
	}})
	lifetime, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 3*time.Second)
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	stream, err := source.Subscribe(lifetime)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := h.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	if err := h.Prepare(t.Context(), remote); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	action := preciseTestAction(t)
	if err := h.Arm(file, request, action); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return &preciseTestFixture{a, h, remote, stream.(*preciseHistoryStream), file, request, action}
}

func preciseTestRename(t *testing.T, f *preciseTestFixture) (storage.FileActionReceipt, *httprest.MutationBarrier) {
	t.Helper()
	receipt, barrier, err := f.file.(httprest.FileWithBarrier).RenameWithBarrier(t.Context(), f.request, f.action)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return receipt, barrier
}

func TestPreciseHistoryHTTPBinding(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
	if !f.history.begun || !f.history.ended || !f.history.finalized || f.history.acknowledged {
		t.Fatal("actual hook capture is incomplete")
	}
	if f.history.events[0].Notification.After != nil || f.history.events[0].Node != nil {
		t.Fatal("removal acquired an invented after-image")
	}
	removedBefore := f.history.events[0].Notification.Before.Location.Ancestors
	renamedBefore := f.history.events[1].Notification.Before.Location.Ancestors
	if removedBefore[len(removedBefore)-1].DirectoryRevision != renamedBefore[len(renamedBefore)-1].DirectoryRevision {
		t.Fatal("test does not exercise same-prestate before images")
	}
	if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// The original action receipt can replay, but no callback can mint a new P/Q.
	replay, replayBarrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
	if (!preciseReceiptMatches(receipt, f.history.receipt) || !preciseReceiptMatches(replay, f.history.receipt)) || !preciseSame(barrier, replayBarrier) || f.authority.position() != f.history.after {
		t.Fatal("replay changed captured interval")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		event, err := f.stream.Next()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		proof, err := f.stream.RetainNotificationProof(event)
		if err != nil || proof == nil {
			t.Fatalf("proof: %v", err)
		}
		mapped, err := smb.DiagnosticMapNotifications(event, 1, 31, true)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := proof.Validate(t.Context(), 1, event.Position, 31, true, mapped); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		proof.Release()
	}
	if !f.history.published || f.history.snapshot != nil || f.history.events != nil {
		t.Fatal("bounded snapshot was not transferred and released")
	}
	for _, record := range f.stream.registry {
		if record.refs != 0 {
			t.Fatal("queued ownership retained")
		}
	}
}

func TestPreciseHistoryAcknowledgmentRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*preciseTestFixture, *storage.FileActionReceipt, **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error
	}{
		{"missing barrier", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, _ *storage.FileActionReceipt, b **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			*b = nil
			return nil
		}},
		{"larger barrier", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, _ *storage.FileActionReceipt, b **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			(*b).Position++
			return nil
		}},
		{"earlier barrier", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, _ *storage.FileActionReceipt, b **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			(*b).Position--
			return nil
		}},
		{"wrong incarnation", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, _ *storage.FileActionReceipt, b **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			(*b).Incarnation = "other"
			return nil
		}},
		{"wrong action", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, r *storage.FileActionReceipt, _ **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			r.Action = "other"
			return nil
		}},
		{"unknown receipt", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, r *storage.FileActionReceipt, _ **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			r.State = 0
			return nil
		}},
		{"wrong effect", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, r *storage.FileActionReceipt, _ **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			r.Effects = storage.EffectContentChanged
			return nil
		}},
		{"changed observation", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, r *storage.FileActionReceipt, _ **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			r.Observation.Attr.ID++
			return nil
		}},
		{"missing original capture", func(f *preciseTestFixture, _ *storage.FileActionReceipt, _ **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			f.history.finalized = false
			return nil
		}},
		{"closed owner", func(f *preciseTestFixture, _ *storage.FileActionReceipt, _ **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			f.history.closed = true
			return nil
		}},
		{"cancelled HTTP result", func(_ *preciseTestFixture, _ *storage.FileActionReceipt, _ **httprest.MutationBarrier) *error {
			err := error(context.Canceled)
			return &err
		}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := preciseTestSetup(t)
			receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
			original := nativeReceiptCopy(receipt)
			var operationErr error
			if err := tc.mutate(f, &receipt, &barrier); err != nil {
				operationErr = *err
			}
			if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, operationErr); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid corroboration admitted")
			}
			if f.history.acknowledged {
				t.Fatal("failure minted provenance")
			}
			f.authority.mu.Lock()
			stored := f.authority.sessions[0].actions[f.action]
			f.authority.mu.Unlock()
			if !preciseReceiptMatches(original, stored.result) || stored.err != nil {
				t.Fatal("diagnostic failure changed successful mutation")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseHistorySnapshotRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	base := make([]metastore.Row, 0, len(f.history.snapshot))
	for _, row := range f.history.snapshot {
		base = append(base, row)
	}
	slices.SortFunc(base, func(a, b metastore.Row) int { return int(a.Node.ID - b.Node.ID) })
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		change func([]metastore.Row) []metastore.Row
	}{
		{"empty", func(_ []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { return nil }},
		{"node bound", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { return append(rows, make([]metastore.Row, 65)...) }},
		{"payload bound", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row {
			rows[3].Node.LinkTarget = make([]byte, preciseMaxBytes)
			return rows
		}},
		{"duplicate node", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { return append(rows, rows[1]) }},
		{"duplicate entry", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].EntryID = rows[2].EntryID; return rows }},
		{"invalid Windows name", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Name = []byte("CON"); return rows }},
		{"case collision", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Name = []byte("TARGET"); return rows }},
		{"missing parent", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Parent = 99; return rows }},
		{"file parent", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Parent = rows[2].Node.ID; return rows }},
		{"cycle", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[1].Parent = rows[1].Node.ID; return rows }},
		{"missing root", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { return rows[1:] }},
		{"bad root entry", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[0].EntryID = 8; return rows }},
		{"negative size", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Node.Size = -1; return rows }},
		{"missing metadata revision", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Node.MetadataRevision = 0; return rows }},
		{"file directory revision", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Node.DirectoryRevision = 1; return rows }},
		{"regular link target", func(rows []metastore.Row) []metastore.Row { rows[3].Node.LinkTarget = []byte("bad"); return rows }},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := preciseRows(tc.change(slices.Clone(base))); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid preimage admitted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseHistoryIntervalRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	preciseTestRename(t, f)
	h := f.history
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		change func([]metastore.Change) []metastore.Change
	}{
		{"missing", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change { return e[:1] }},
		{"extra", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change { return append(e, e[1]) }},
		{"duplicate", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change { e[1] = e[0]; return e }},
		{"reverse", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change { e[0], e[1] = e[1], e[0]; return e }},
		{"gap", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change { e[1].Position++; return e }},
		{"wrong before revision", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change {
			e[1].Notification.Before.Location.Ancestors[1].DirectoryRevision++
			return e
		}},
		{"wrong before entry", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change {
			e[0].Notification.Before.Location.Ancestors[1].EntryID++
			return e
		}},
		{"wrong after parent revision", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change {
			e[1].Notification.After.Location.Ancestors[1].DirectoryRevision++
			return e
		}},
		{"wrong after ancestor identity", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change {
			e[1].Notification.After.Location.Ancestors[0].EntryID++
			return e
		}},
		{"removed synthetic after", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change {
			e[0].Notification.After = e[0].Notification.Before
			return e
		}},
		{"wrong subject", func(e []metastore.Change) []metastore.Change { e[1].Notification.SubjectID++; return e }},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			events := make([]metastore.Change, 2)
			for i, e := range h.events {
				copy, err := preciseCopyChange(e)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				events[i] = copy
			}
			if err := preciseInterval(h.snapshot, h.before, h.after, h.request, tc.change(events)); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid atomic interval admitted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseHistoryMutationCaptureRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*preciseTestFixture)
	}{
		{"wrong session", func(f *preciseTestFixture) { f.history.session++ }},
		{"wrong reference", func(f *preciseTestFixture) { f.history.reference++ }},
		{"wrong fingerprint", func(f *preciseTestFixture) { f.history.fingerprint[0] ^= 1 }},
		{"preposition changed", func(f *preciseTestFixture) { f.history.before-- }},
		{"wrong source incarnation", func(f *preciseTestFixture) { f.history.incarnation = "other" }},
		{"duplicate capture", func(f *preciseTestFixture) { f.history.begun = true }},
		{"wrong request", func(f *preciseTestFixture) { f.history.request.Destination.Name = []byte("other") }},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := preciseTestSetup(t)
			tc.change(f)
			receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
			if receipt.State != storage.FileActionCompleted || receipt.Effects != storage.EffectEntryMoved {
				t.Fatal("probe changed successful mutation")
			}
			if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("capture mismatch admitted")
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("replay without original capture", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := preciseTestSetup(t)
		receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
		f.history.begun = false
		f.history.ended = false
		f.history.finalized = false
		f.history.events = nil
		replay, replayBarrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
		if (!preciseReceiptMatches(receipt, f.history.receipt) || !preciseReceiptMatches(replay, f.history.receipt)) || !preciseSame(barrier, replayBarrier) {
			t.Fatal("replay changed mutation")
		}
		if err := f.history.Acknowledge(replay, replayBarrier, nil); err == nil || f.history.begun {
			t.Fatal("replay minted missing interval")
		}
	})
	t.Run("unrelated mutation advances P", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := preciseTestSetup(t)
		// A real unrelated namespace action advances the captured pre-position.
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		if _, err := f.authority.sessions[0].SetNodeAttr(t.Context(), 1, storage.AttrChange{ModTime: &now}, preciseTestAction(t)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
		if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("intervening mutation admitted")
		}
	})
}

func TestPreciseHistoryProofOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
	if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	event, err := f.stream.Next()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mapped, err := smb.DiagnosticMapNotifications(event, 1, 31, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	retain := func() *preciseProof {
		t.Helper()
		proof, err := f.stream.RetainNotificationProof(event)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return proof.(*preciseProof)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name      string
		root      uint64
		position  metastore.Position
		filter    uint32
		recursive bool
		events    []wire.Notification
	}{
		{"wrong root", 2, event.Position, 31, true, mapped},
		{"wrong position", 1, event.Position + 1, 31, true, mapped},
		{"wrong filter", 1, event.Position, 1, true, mapped},
		{"nonrecursive", 1, event.Position, 31, false, mapped},
		{"missing mapped detail", 1, event.Position, 31, true, nil},
		{"invented mapped detail", 1, event.Position, 31, true, []wire.Notification{{Action: 2, Name: "other"}}},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			proof := retain()
			defer proof.Release()
			if err := proof.Validate(t.Context(), tc.root, tc.position, tc.filter, tc.recursive, tc.events); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("unbound delivery admitted")
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("changed event retain", func(t *testing.T) {
		changed := event
		changed.Name = []byte("other")
		if _, err := f.stream.RetainNotificationProof(changed); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("forged event retained")
		}
	})
	t.Run("reference bound", func(t *testing.T) {
		proofs := make([]*preciseProof, 8)
		for i := range proofs {
			proofs[i] = retain()
		}
		if _, err := f.stream.RetainNotificationProof(event); err == nil {
			t.Error("excess proof admitted")
		}
		for _, proof := range proofs {
			proof.Release()
		}
	})
	t.Run("cancelled validation", func(t *testing.T) {
		proof := retain()
		defer proof.Release()
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
		cancel()
		if !errors.Is(proof.Validate(ctx, 1, event.Position, 31, true, mapped), context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatal("cancel ignored")
		}
	})
	t.Run("released token", func(t *testing.T) {
		proof := retain()
		proof.Release()
		if err := proof.Validate(t.Context(), 1, event.Position, 31, true, mapped); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("released token reused")
		}
	})
	t.Run("source generation", func(t *testing.T) {
		proof := retain()
		defer proof.Release()
		f.history.mu.Lock()
		f.history.generation++
		f.history.mu.Unlock()
		if err := proof.Validate(t.Context(), 1, event.Position, 31, true, mapped); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("old generation admitted")
		}
		f.history.mu.Lock()
		f.history.generation--
		f.history.mu.Unlock()
	})
	t.Run("close does not wait for queued references", func(t *testing.T) {
		proof := retain()
		if err := f.stream.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := proof.Validate(t.Context(), 1, event.Position, 31, true, mapped); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("closed source admitted")
		}
		proof.Release()
	})
}

func TestPreciseHistoryShutdownRace(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
	if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	event, err := f.stream.Next()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mapped, err := smb.DiagnosticMapNotifications(event, 1, 31, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	start := make(chan struct{})
	for range 8 {
		proof, err := f.stream.RetainNotificationProof(event)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		wg.Go(func() {
			<-start
			err := proof.Validate(context.Background(), 1, event.Position, 31, true, mapped)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, smb.ErrNotifyRescan) {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			proof.Release()
		})
	}
	close(start)
	if err := f.stream.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	f.stream.mu.Lock()
	defer f.stream.mu.Unlock()
	if f.stream.pins != 0 || !f.stream.closed || len(f.stream.registry) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("source shutdown retained registry or admitted validation")
	}
}

type preciseTestStream struct {
	events []metastore.Change
	index  int
	done   chan struct{}
	once   sync.Once
	second chan struct{}
}

func (s *preciseTestStream) Next() (metastore.Change, error) {
	if s.index >= len(s.events) {
		<-s.done
		return metastore.Change{}, context.Canceled
	}
	event := s.events[s.index]
	s.index++
	if s.index == 2 && s.second != nil {
		close(s.second)
	}
	return event, nil
}
func (s *preciseTestStream) Close() error                     { s.once.Do(func() { close(s.done) }); return nil }
func (*preciseTestStream) Incarnation() metastore.Incarnation { return "fake" }
func (*preciseTestStream) Position() metastore.Position       { return 0 }

func TestPreciseHistoryWholeIntervalDelivery(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"wait for acknowledgment", "mismatched actual second", "gap actual second", "close while waiting", "missing actual second"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := preciseTestSetup(t)
			receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
			events := make([]metastore.Change, 2)
			for i, event := range f.history.events {
				copy, err := preciseCopyChange(event)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				events[i] = copy
			}
			if mode == "mismatched actual second" {
				events[1].Name = []byte("forged")
			}
			if mode == "gap actual second" {
				events[1].Position++
			}
			if mode == "missing actual second" {
				events = events[:1]
			}
			if err := f.stream.upstream.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fake := &preciseTestStream{events: events, done: make(chan struct{}), second: make(chan struct{})}
			f.stream.upstream = fake
			result := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() { _, err := f.stream.Next(); result <- err }()
			if mode == "missing actual second" {
				if err := f.stream.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := <-result; err == nil {
					t.Fatal("missing second event delivered")
				}
				return
			}
			<-fake.second
			if mode == "wait for acknowledgment" {
				select {
				case err := <-result:
					t.Fatalf("interval escaped before HTTP acknowledgment: %v", err)
				case <-time.After(5 * time.Millisecond):
				}
				if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := <-result; err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else if mode == "close while waiting" {
				if err := f.stream.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := <-result; err == nil {
					t.Fatal("closed source delivered")
				}
			} else {
				if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := <-result; err == nil {
					t.Fatal("invalid delivered interval exposed a prefix")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

type preciseTruncatedSnapshotWriter struct{ http.ResponseWriter }

func (w preciseTruncatedSnapshotWriter) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	if bytes.Contains(data, []byte("event: done")) {
		return len(data), nil
	}
	return w.ResponseWriter.Write(data)
}
func (w preciseTruncatedSnapshotWriter) Flush() { w.ResponseWriter.(http.Flusher).Flush() }

func TestPreciseHistorySnapshotMustReachSemanticEOF(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	handler, err := httprest.NewHandler(f.authority, f.authority)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { handler.ServeHTTP(preciseTruncatedSnapshotWriter{w}, r) }))
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		handler.Stop()
		server.Close()
		if err := handler.Close(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	remote, err := httprest.Dial(server.URL, server.Client())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	history := &preciseHistory{authority: f.authority, incarnation: f.history.incarnation, ready: make(chan struct{})}
	if err := history.Prepare(t.Context(), remote); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("transport EOF stood in for semantic EOF")
	}
	if history.snapshot != nil || history.snapshotCount != 0 {
		t.Fatal("partial snapshot retained")
	}
}

func TestPreciseHistorySnapshotSourceIncarnation(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	h := &preciseHistory{authority: f.authority, incarnation: "different", ready: make(chan struct{})}
	if err := h.Prepare(t.Context(), f.remote); err == nil || h.snapshot != nil {
		t.Fatal("snapshot bound to a different source incarnation")
	}
}

func TestPreciseHistoryEvidenceOwnsBoundedFacts(t *testing.T) {
	f := preciseTestSetup(t)
	receipt, barrier := preciseTestRename(t, f)
	if err := f.history.Acknowledge(receipt, barrier, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for range 2 {
		if _, err := f.stream.Next(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	evidence := f.history.Evidence()
	if !evidence.Published || evidence.Error != "" || evidence.EvidenceBytes <= 0 || evidence.EvidenceBytes > preciseMaxEvidenceBytes || evidence.Fingerprint != evidence.StoredFingerprint {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete evidence: %+v", evidence)
	}
	var rows []metastore.Row
	var captured, delivered []metastore.Change
	var request storage.RenameRequest
	var stored storage.FileActionReceipt
	var acknowledgment struct {
		Receipt storage.FileActionReceipt
		Barrier *httprest.MutationBarrier
		Error   string
	}
	for _, field := range []struct {
		data   []byte
		target any
	}{
		{evidence.Payload.PreSnapshot, &rows}, {evidence.Payload.CapturedEvents, &captured},
		{evidence.Payload.DeliveredEvents, &delivered}, {evidence.Payload.Request, &request},
		{evidence.Payload.StoredReceipt, &stored}, {evidence.Payload.Acknowledgment, &acknowledgment},
	} {
		if len(field.data) == 0 {
			t.Fatal("missing raw evidence")
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(field.data, field.target); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	tree, err := preciseRows(rows)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := preciseInterval(tree, evidence.Before, evidence.After, request, captured); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("archived interval cannot be verified:", err)
	}
	if !preciseSame(captured, delivered) || !preciseReceiptMatches(acknowledgment.Receipt, stored) || acknowledgment.Error != "" || !preciseSame(acknowledgment.Barrier, barrier) {
		t.Fatal("archived capture and source/HTTP outcomes disagree")
	}
	owned := f.history.Evidence()
	evidence.Payload.CapturedEvents[0] = '!'
	if bytes.Equal(evidence.Payload.CapturedEvents, owned.Payload.CapturedEvents) || !bytes.Equal(owned.Payload.CapturedEvents, f.history.Evidence().Payload.CapturedEvents) {
		t.Fatal("evidence aliases source-owned bytes")
	}
	if err := f.history.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cleanup := f.history.Evidence()
	if !cleanup.Closed || cleanup.SourceCount != 0 || cleanup.EvidenceBytes != 0 || len(cleanup.Payload.PreSnapshot) != 0 || len(cleanup.Payload.CapturedEvents) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("owner cleanup retained serialized facts")
	}
	if !json.Valid(owned.Payload.CapturedEvents) {
		t.Fatal("source cleanup invalidated the archived owned snapshot")
	}
}

func TestPreciseHistoryEvidenceBoundPreservesFirstFacts(t *testing.T) {
	h := &preciseHistory{}
	if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.PreSnapshot, []int{1}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	first := bytes.Clone(h.evidence.PreSnapshot)
	if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.PreSnapshot, []int{2}); err == nil || !bytes.Equal(first, h.evidence.PreSnapshot) {
		t.Fatal("earlier evidence overwritten")
	}
	h.evidenceBytes = preciseMaxEvidenceBytes
	if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.Request, []int{3}); !errors.Is(err, syscall.EFBIG) || len(h.evidence.Request) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("evidence bound admitted excess retained bytes")
	}
}
